content: {"episode_id":"ep-05107","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-22","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate control management. This appeal requests reconsideration based on that documented clinical indication; the payer letter identifies a coordination-of-benefits denial under CO-22 and requests the primary carrier's Explanation of Benefits before further review."}
